digest.component_or_area: Ruff linting configuration and RUF rule family enablement
propositions: The RUF rule family must be added to the global Ruff configuration with RUF001, RUF002, and RUF003 deferred in [tool.ruff.lint].ignore due to intentional Unicode usage in prose and UI content.
The test suite must assert that [tool.ruff.lint].select contains RUF, that [tool.ruff.lint].ignore is exactly the three-item set [RUF001, RUF002, RUF003], and that extend-ignore is absent.
All actionable RUF diagnostics (excluding RUF001/002/003/100 artifacts) reported by the narrow-selection baseline command must be remediated across src/rebar and tests files.
Per-file-ignores configuration must be validated to contain no RUF selector or RUF-prefixed codes, preventing per-file RUF exemptions.
After RUF family is fully enabled, stale RUF100 suppressions must be removed from the codebase under the complete configured rule set, and ruff check must exit 0.
